tasks.subject: Task 1: Widen fills with the dropped columns
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Stop discarding builderFee, hash, oid and feeToken on ingest.

**Files:**
- Modify: db.js (SCHEMA, migration, insertFill, ingestTxn + FILL_DEFAULTS)
- Modify: hyperliquid.js (normalizeFills)
- Test: test/db.test.js, test/hyperliquid.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Fresh DBs create fills with builder_fee, hash, oid, fee_token
- [ ] Pre-existing DBs gain all four without losing rows
- [ ] Migration is data-driven (replaces the one-off dir migration)
- [ ] normalizeFills carries all four, tolerates absence; absent builderFee is 0 not null
- [ ] Callers omitting the new keys still insert (FILL_DEFAULTS)

**Verify:** npm test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["db.js", "hyperliquid.js", "test/db.test.js", "test/hyperliquid.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["four columns on fresh DB", "additive migration preserves rows", "data-driven migration loop", "normalizeFills carries all four", "FILL_DEFAULTS keeps old callers working"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: backfillFills enrichment upsert
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A write path that fills NULL columns on existing rows, which INSERT OR IGNORE cannot do.

**Files:**
- Modify: db.js (backfillFill statement, backfillTxn, backfillFills method)
- Test: test/db.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] New fill inserts normally
- [ ] Existing NULL dir/builder_fee/hash/oid/fee_token get filled via COALESCE
- [ ] Already-populated values are NOT overwritten
- [ ] Money columns (closed_pnl, fee, px, sz) never rewritten
- [ ] Returns { scanned, inserted, enriched }; counts derived from before/after totals because SQLite reports a change for no-op DO UPDATE

**Verify:** npm test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["db.js", "test/db.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["COALESCE fills nulls", "existing values preserved", "money columns immutable", "scanned/inserted/enriched counts correct"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: backfill.js + backfill route
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Page through Hyperliquid history without skipping same-millisecond rows or looping forever.

**Files:**
- Create: backfill.js, test/backfill.test.js
- Modify: server.js (POST /api/backfill/:address), test/server.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Advances cursor TO newest ts, not +1 (same-ms rows not skipped)
- [ ] Terminates on a page yielding no new rows; one retry when the page brought rows but the cursor couldn't advance
- [ ] Idempotent second run inserts nothing
- [ ] 50-page ceiling sets truncated: true
- [ ] Gates on db.hasWallet -> { skipped: true } so a backfill can't resurrect a deleted wallet
- [ ] Fetchers injected; tests need no network

**Verify:** npm test

**Note:** pagination loop verified against all 6 scenarios by prototype before the plan was written.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["backfill.js", "server.js", "test/backfill.test.js", "test/server.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cursor advances TO newest", "terminates on no-new-rows", "idempotent", "page ceiling reports truncated", "hasWallet gate", "injected fetchers"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: export.js CSV generation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Turn stored fills and funding into two CSV shapes, correctly escaped and chronologically merged.

**Files:**
- Create: export.js, test/export.test.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] toCsv quotes fields with comma/quote/newline, doubles internal quotes (RFC 4180, CRLF)
- [ ] Fills and funding merge chronologically
- [ ] Funding rows carry no explorer URL (zero-filled hash)
- [ ] Real hashes produce https://app.hyperliquid.xyz/explorer/tx/<hash>
- [ ] Full numeric precision, no display rounding
- [ ] Empty dataset yields header only
- [ ] time_local honours the IANA tz, falls back on an invalid one
- [ ] buildPreamble records wallet, range, timezone, not-tax-advice note

**Verify:** npm test

**Note:** escaping, preamble, and tz output verified by prototype before the plan was written.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["export.js", "test/export.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["RFC4180 escaping", "chronological merge", "funding has no link", "explorer URL for real hashes", "precision preserved", "header-only when empty", "tz-aware local time", "preamble content"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: export and range routes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Serve the CSVs as downloads and report the data span for the year picker.

**Files:**
- Modify: db.js (listFillsRange, getRange), server.js (two routes)
- Test: test/db.test.js, test/server.test.js, test/export.test.js (reconciliation)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] text/csv with Content-Disposition filename
- [ ] format=detailed|koinly differ; anything else 400
- [ ] from/to half-open; omitting both exports everything
- [ ] Invalid address 400
- [ ] GET /api/range returns { minTs, maxTs } across fills AND funding
- [ ] Detailed CSV carries the # preamble; Koinly starts at its header
- [ ] RECONCILIATION: CSV column sums equal direct SQL sums over the same range

**Verify:** npm test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["db.js", "server.js", "test/db.test.js", "test/server.test.js", "test/export.test.js"], "verifyCommand": "npm test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["csv content-type and disposition", "format validation", "half-open range", "range spans both tables", "preamble on detailed only", "totals reconcile with SQL"]}
```
